Strategic Consultancy

The Blueprint Before the Build

Every sound investment begins with sound information. We produce the technical and financial documentation that governments, lenders, and donors require before a single machine breaks ground — giving decision-makers the clarity to commit with confidence.

Commission a Study
01

Detailed Project Reports (DPR)

Topographic survey, full engineering design, cost estimation, environmental and social assessment, and implementation scheduling — compiled to approval-ready standards for government and institutional submission.

02

Feasibility & Valuation Studies

Independent, data-led assessment of technical viability, financial return, and project risk — the due diligence layer that protects every stakeholder before ground is broken.

Engineering & Construction

One Firm. One Mandate.

“We carry the work from first survey to final handover under a single accountable roof — because divided responsibility is where quality is lost.”
Discuss a Project

Roads & Bridges

Alignment surveys, structural design, and full construction supervision for durable connectivity across Karnali Province's demanding terrain — rural routes through to load-rated bridges.

Water Supply Systems

Source hydrological assessment, distribution network engineering, and turnkey execution for community gravity schemes and municipal reticulation — from intake to tap.

Structural & Civil Works

Foundation to finish — retaining structures, institutional buildings, and general civil works executed with in-house quality control at every stage of the build programme.

We engineer for the decades ahead — not the contract in hand.

Renewable Energy Solutions

Designed for the Long Horizon

Solar energy is only as good as the engineering behind it. We size systems to genuine load, specify for longevity over cost, and remain on call long after commissioning — because a system that fails in year three was never truly built.

Explore Energy Solutions

Solar Rooftop Systems

Custom load-analysis and system design for residential, institutional, and industrial premises. Every installation is engineered, not templated — from shading analysis through inverter selection to warranty-backed commissioning.

Solar Water Pumping

Variable-frequency drive and direct-coupled pumping systems engineered for mountain hydrology — reliable, low-maintenance water access for agriculture and remote communities.

System Manufacturing

In-house fabrication of galvanised mounting structures and balance-of-system components. Built to specification, climate-tested, and ready to install — removing the supply-chain uncertainty from every project.
